counterfactual_missing_items: positive blood culture or mNGS pathogen result
decisive_items: complaints of hemoptysis, fever, and difficulty exhaling
Blood gas analysis showed type II respiratory failure
diffuse inflammatory changes in both lungs
response.rationale: R1 uniquely integrates the full raw syndrome: fever/hemoptysis, bilateral exudative/diffuse infiltrates, and type II respiratory failure. R3 captures fever and shock but lacks lung-specific raw evidence. R5 has lung/imaging spans but is disconfirmed by type II respiratory failure (ARDS is typically hypoxemic) and omits fever/hemoptysis. R2 is under-supported by a single raw span.

rejected.why: ARDS is atypical with type II respiratory failure; raw spans are nonspecific and omit fever/hemoptysis; more a complication than primary diagnosis.
Only one raw support span; broad syndrome label under-specified and lacks fever/imaging evidence.
